frame: Godot Y-up, metres; same origin as the exterior GLB; node +Y = direction, node +Z = up

gravity.note: on the Mars surface: 3.71 m/s^2 toward -Y (floor down); during ascent the thrust acceleration is along +Y (crew pressed into the upright couches); after MECO / in orbit zero-g
